name: raychat
title: RayChat
description: Ask DeepSeek a one-off question straight from the Raycast search bar, with streaming answers and collapsible reasoning.
author: edy

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask Rafa
commands.subtitle: RayChat
commands.description: Send a single question to DeepSeek and stream the answer.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your DeepSeek API key. Stored locally in Raycast, never committed to this repository.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Model id passed to the chat completions endpoint.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Change it to point at a proxy or another provider.

preferences.name: systemPrompt
preferences.title: System Prompt
preferences.description: Sent as the system message on every request. Tuned for one-off questions in a narrow panel — edit it freely.
preferences.default: You are answering a single question inside Raycast. There is no conversation history and no way for the user to reply, so never ask a clarifying question — pick the most reasonable reading and say in one line which one you picked if it matters. Answer in the language the question was asked in. Lead with the answer: no preamble, no restating the question, no offer of further help. Keep it as short as the question allows; a fact deserves a sentence, not an essay. Format as GitHub-flavored Markdown for a narrow column — short paragraphs, bullets over tables, fenced code blocks with a language tag, headings only when the answer has genuinely separate sections.

preferences.name: thinking
preferences.title: Thinking
preferences.label: Enable thinking
preferences.description: Ask the model to think before answering. The reasoning is shown collapsed above the answer.

preferences.name: reasoningEffort
preferences.title: Reasoning Effort
preferences.description: How much effort the model spends thinking. Only used when thinking is enabled.
